<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no">
<title>Wave Tunnel</title>
<!--
  Ported from a dwitter/OpenProcessing "cantaloupe wave" tunnel sketch to a
  standalone p5.js page, in the same collapsible-right-panel + video
  recorder style used by ../contourLines/index.html.

  Note for decoding dwitter sources that contain escaped/CJK-looking
  characters: paste this into the Firefox console with the dweet's body
  substituted in, then feed the printed result to an LLM to port to p5:
    console.log(unescape(escape`<dweet code here>`.replace(/u../g,'')))
-->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@1.11.13/lib/p5.min.js"></script>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #000;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* Layout: a canvas stage next to a collapsible right-hand panel,
     plus a fixed arrow button that toggles the panel. */
  #app {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #stage {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  #stage canvas {
    touch-action: none;
    display: block;
  }

  #panel-toggle {
    position: fixed;
    top: 12px;
    right: 12px;
    z-index: 20;
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1;
    background: #111;
    color: #0fc;
    border: 1px solid #ffffff2a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #panel-toggle:hover {
    background: #0fc;
    color: #000;
  }

  #panel {
    width: 260px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: width 0.25s ease;
  }
  #panel.collapsed {
    width: 0;
  }
  .panel-inner {
    width: 260px;
    height: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow-y: auto;
    background-color: #111;
    border-left: 1px solid #ffffff1a;
    padding: 52px 10px 16px;
    color: #0fc;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .panel-title,
  .panel-section-title {
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: #0fc;
    opacity: 0.7;
    margin: 0 0 8px;
    padding-bottom: 5px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ffffff1a;
  }
  .panel-section-title {
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  .slider-line {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .slider-line:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }
  .slider-block {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .slider-label {
    width: 82px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    color: #0fc;
  }
  .slider-container {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .slider-value {
    width: 44px;
    text-align: right;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    color: #0fc;
  }

  input[type="range"] {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 18px;
    background: #222;
    outline: none;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 40px;
    height: 18px;
    background: #0fc;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 3px;
  }
  input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 40px;
    height: 18px;
    background: #0fc;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 3px;
    border: none;
  }

  #record-btn {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 8px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    background: #222;
    color: #0fc;
    border: 1px solid #ffffff2a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #record-btn:hover {
    background: #0fc;
    color: #000;
  }
  #record-btn.recording {
    background: #ff4d4d;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: transparent;
  }
  #record-btn:disabled {
    opacity: 0.45;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }
  .record-time {
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #0fc;
    opacity: 0.8;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }
  .record-status {
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #ff8080;
    margin-top: 4px;
    min-height: 12px;
  }

  .style-toggle {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .style-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 6px 4px;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    background: #222;
    color: #0fc;
    border: 1px solid #ffffff2a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .style-btn:hover {
    background: #333;
  }
  .style-btn.active {
    background: #0fc;
    color: #000;
  }

  /* Mobile: the panel becomes a bottom drawer instead of a side panel */
  @media (max-width: 700px) {
    #app { flex-direction: column; }
    #stage { flex: 1 1 auto; }

    #panel {
      width: 100%;
      height: 0;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      transition: height 0.25s ease;
    }
    #panel.collapsed {
      width: 100%;
      height: 0;
    }
    #panel:not(.collapsed) {
      height: auto;
      max-height: 55vh;
    }
    .panel-inner {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      max-height: 55vh;
      border-left: none;
      border-top: 1px solid #ffffff1a;
      padding: 14px 10px 16px;
    }
    #panel-toggle {
      top: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      font-size: 15px;
      transform: rotate(90deg);
    }
    .slider-label { width: 92px; font-size: 11px; }
    .slider-value { font-size: 11px; }
    input[type="range"] { height: 24px; }
    input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb,
    input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb { height: 24px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script>
// Fixed column count of the point grid ("o" in the original dweet). Each
// point's row (its "line" going into the screen) is index // COLS.
const COLS = 120;

// Must match #panel's width and the mobile breakpoint in the CSS above.
const PANEL_WIDTH = 260;
const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 700;

let B = [];

let speedSlider, waveSlider, intensitySlider, zoomSlider, pointsSlider, pointSizeSlider, spacingSlider, widthSpacingSlider;
let speedVal, waveVal, intensityVal, zoomVal, pointsVal, pointSizeVal, spacingVal, widthSpacingVal;

// Point rendering style: 'square' (fillRect, matches the original dweet) or
// 'circle' ("boules" — filled disc via arc()).
let pointStyle = 'square';
let squareStyleBtn, circleStyleBtn;

let cnv;
let appEl, stageEl, panelEl, toggleBtn;

// Video recording (MediaRecorder + canvas.captureStream)
let mediaRecorder = null;
let recordedChunks = [];
let isRecording = false;
let recordStartFrame = 0;
let recordBtn, recordTimeDisplay, recordStatusDisplay;
const RECORD_MIME_CANDIDATES = [
  'video/webm;codecs=vp9',
  'video/webm;codecs=vp8',
  'video/webm',
  'video/mp4'
];

function setup() {
  buildLayout();

  const size = computeCanvasSize();
  cnv = createCanvas(size.w, size.h);
  cnv.parent(stageEl);

  initGrid();
}

function windowResized() {
  const size = computeCanvasSize();
  resizeCanvas(size.w, size.h);
}

function isMobileLayout() {
  return windowWidth <= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT;
}

// Fit the canvas inside the space left over by the panel (a side column
// on desktop, a bottom drawer on mobile).
function computeCanvasSize() {
  const mobile = isMobileLayout();
  const panelOpen = !panelEl.elt.classList.contains('collapsed');

  let w, h;
  if (mobile) {
    const panelH = panelOpen ? panelEl.elt.offsetHeight : 0;
    w = windowWidth;
    h = windowHeight - panelH;
  } else {
    const panelW = panelOpen ? PANEL_WIDTH : 0;
    w = windowWidth - panelW;
    h = windowHeight;
  }

  return { w: Math.max(Math.floor(w), 100), h: Math.max(Math.floor(h), 100) };
}

function initGrid() {
  B = [];
  const num = pointsSlider.value();
  for (let i = 0; i < num; i++) {
    B.push([i % COLS - COLS / 2, Math.floor(i / COLS)]);
  }
}

function draw() {
  background(0);

  const x = drawingContext;
  const t = millis() / 1000;
  const S = Math.sin;
  const C = Math.cos;

  x.fillStyle = 'white';

  if (B.length !== pointsSlider.value()) initGrid();

  const speed = speedSlider.value();
  const waveFreq = waveSlider.value();
  const intensity = intensitySlider.value();
  const zoom = zoomSlider.value();
  const pointScale = pointSizeSlider.value();
  const rowSpacing = spacingSlider.value();
  const widthSpacing = widthSpacingSlider.value();
  const drawCircles = pointStyle === 'circle';

  B.forEach(v => {
    // Depth (Z) along the conveyor. Rows are rowSpacing world-units apart;
    // the animation subtracts the same period so the loop stays seamless
    // regardless of spacing (rowSpacing === 1 reproduces the original).
    const Z = v[1] * rowSpacing - (t * speed * rowSpacing) % rowSpacing;

    if (Z <= 0.1) return; // guard against division by zero

    // Cantaloupe-wave height field. The wave phase uses the raw (unscaled)
    // column index so widthSpacing only changes physical spacing on screen,
    // not the wave's spatial frequency.
    const waveX = v[0] / waveFreq + C(t / 8) * 9;
    const waveZ = Z / 9 - S(t / 8) * 9;
    const l = Math.pow(3 + C(waveX) * C(waveZ), intensity);

    const hFinal = l > 50 ? 50 : l;

    // Perspective projection. widthSpacing spreads/tightens points sideways
    // (across each row) before the perspective divide.
    const size = (zoom / Z / 10) * pointScale;
    const posX = width / 2 + ((v[0] * widthSpacing) / Z) * zoom;
    const posY = (hFinal / Z) * (height / 2) + height / 3; // shifted down to keep the horizon in view

    if (drawCircles) {
      x.beginPath();
      x.arc(posX + size / 2, posY + size / 2, size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      x.fill();
    } else {
      x.fillRect(posX, posY, size, size);
    }
  });

  // Live value readouts
  speedVal.html(speed.toFixed(1));
  waveVal.html(waveFreq.toFixed(1));
  intensityVal.html(intensity.toFixed(1));
  zoomVal.html(zoom.toFixed(0));
  pointsVal.html(pointsSlider.value());
  pointSizeVal.html(pointScale.toFixed(1));
  spacingVal.html(rowSpacing.toFixed(1));
  widthSpacingVal.html(widthSpacing.toFixed(2));

  if (isRecording) {
    const elapsed = (frameCount - recordStartFrame) / 60;
    recordTimeDisplay.html('Duration: ' + elapsed.toFixed(1) + ' s');
  }
}

// ---- Layout: collapsible right-hand panel + toggle arrow -----------------

function buildLayout() {
  appEl = createDiv().id('app');
  stageEl = createDiv().id('stage').parent(appEl);
  panelEl = createDiv().id('panel').parent(appEl);

  const panelInner = createDiv().class('panel-inner').parent(panelEl);
  createDiv('Controls').class('panel-title').parent(panelInner);

  setupInterface(panelInner);
  buildPointStyleSection(panelInner);
  buildRecordSection(panelInner);

  toggleBtn = createButton('▸').id('panel-toggle').parent(appEl);
  toggleBtn.mousePressed(togglePanel);
}

function togglePanel() {
  const collapsed = panelEl.elt.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  toggleBtn.html(collapsed ? '◂' : '▸');

  const size = computeCanvasSize();
  resizeCanvas(size.w, size.h);
}

function setupInterface(parent) {
  const line1 = createDiv().parent(parent).addClass('slider-line');
  createSliderBlock(line1, 'Speed', 1, 20, 9, 0.1, (s) => speedSlider = s, (v) => speedVal = v);
  createSliderBlock(line1, 'Wave Freq.', 1, 20, 8, 0.1, (s) => waveSlider = s, (v) => waveVal = v);
  createSliderBlock(line1, 'Peak Intensity', 1, 6, 4, 0.1, (s) => intensitySlider = s, (v) => intensityVal = v);

  const line2 = createDiv().parent(parent).addClass('slider-line');
  createSliderBlock(line2, 'Perspective', 100, 1500, 500, 10, (s) => zoomSlider = s, (v) => zoomVal = v);
  createSliderBlock(line2, 'Resolution', 5000, 30000, 20000, 1000, (s) => pointsSlider = s, (v) => pointsVal = v);
  createSliderBlock(line2, 'Point Size', 0.1, 5, 1, 0.1, (s) => pointSizeSlider = s, (v) => pointSizeVal = v);

  const line3 = createDiv().parent(parent).addClass('slider-line');
  createSliderBlock(line3, 'Row Spacing', 0.2, 5, 1, 0.1, (s) => spacingSlider = s, (v) => spacingVal = v);
  createSliderBlock(line3, 'Width Spacing', 0.3, 3, 1, 0.05, (s) => widthSpacingSlider = s, (v) => widthSpacingVal = v);
}

function buildPointStyleSection(parent) {
  createDiv('Point Style').class('panel-section-title').parent(parent);

  const row = createDiv().parent(parent).addClass('style-toggle');
  squareStyleBtn = createButton('■ Square').parent(row).addClass('style-btn active');
  circleStyleBtn = createButton('● Circle').parent(row).addClass('style-btn');

  squareStyleBtn.mousePressed(() => setPointStyle('square'));
  circleStyleBtn.mousePressed(() => setPointStyle('circle'));
}

function setPointStyle(style) {
  pointStyle = style;
  if (style === 'square') {
    squareStyleBtn.addClass('active');
    circleStyleBtn.removeClass('active');
  } else {
    circleStyleBtn.addClass('active');
    squareStyleBtn.removeClass('active');
  }
}

function createSliderBlock(parent, labelTxt, minVal, maxVal, def, step, storeSlider, storeVal) {
  const block = createDiv().parent(parent).addClass('slider-block');

  createDiv(labelTxt).parent(block).addClass('slider-label');

  const container = createDiv().parent(block).addClass('slider-container');
  const s = createSlider(minVal, maxVal, def, step).parent(container);
  s.doubleClicked(() => s.value(def));
  storeSlider(s);

  const valDiv = createDiv(def).parent(block).addClass('slider-value');
  storeVal(valDiv);
}

// ---- Video recording (MediaRecorder + canvas.captureStream) --------------

function isRecordingSupported() {
  return typeof MediaRecorder !== 'undefined' &&
    typeof HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.captureStream === 'function';
}

function pickSupportedMimeType() {
  for (const type of RECORD_MIME_CANDIDATES) {
    if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(type)) return type;
  }
  return '';
}

function buildRecordSection(parent) {
  createDiv('Recording').class('panel-section-title').parent(parent);

  recordBtn = createButton('● Record').id('record-btn').parent(parent);
  recordBtn.mousePressed(toggleRecording);

  recordTimeDisplay = createDiv('Duration: 0.0 s').class('record-time').parent(parent);
  recordStatusDisplay = createDiv('').class('record-status').parent(parent);

  if (!isRecordingSupported()) {
    recordStatusDisplay.html('Video recording is not supported in this browser.');
    recordBtn.attribute('disabled', '');
  }
}

function toggleRecording() {
  if (isRecording) stopRecording();
  else startRecording();
}

function startRecording() {
  if (isRecording || !isRecordingSupported()) return;

  recordedChunks = [];
  const stream = cnv.elt.captureStream(60);
  const mimeType = pickSupportedMimeType();

  try {
    mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, mimeType ? { mimeType } : undefined);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[record] MediaRecorder unavailable', e);
    recordStatusDisplay.html('Could not start recording in this browser.');
    return;
  }

  mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
    if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) recordedChunks.push(e.data);
  };
  mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
    if (recordedChunks.length > 0) {
      const blob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'video/webm' });
      downloadBlob(blob, buildRecordingFilename(blob.type));
    }
    isRecording = false;
    recordBtn.html('● Record');
    recordBtn.removeClass('recording');
  };

  mediaRecorder.start();
  isRecording = true;
  recordStartFrame = frameCount;
  recordStatusDisplay.html('');
  recordBtn.html('■ Stop');
  recordBtn.addClass('recording');
}

function stopRecording() {
  if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
    mediaRecorder.stop();
  }
}

function downloadBlob(blob, filename) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = createElement('a').attribute('href', url).attribute('download', filename);
  a.elt.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

function buildRecordingFilename(mimeType) {
  const ext = mimeType.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';
  const duration = ((frameCount - recordStartFrame) / 60).toFixed(1);
  return `wave-tunnel_${duration}s.${ext}`;
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
